info.name: Wine red google theme XD
info.description:
Give your Google experience a bold, elegant makeover with this Dark Maroon/Wine Red theme. From Search to Gmail, Drive to Docs, this style wraps Google in rich hues of burgundy, deep crimson, and black for a clean, moody aesthetic.

✦ Perfect for night owls, minimalists, and anyone who loves that dark academia or velvet-red vibe.
✦ Works across most Google services, including Search, Gmail, Docs, Drive, and more.
✦ Say goodbye to blinding whites—this theme is easy on the eyes and high on style.

? Because your browser deserves to look as good as your Pinterest board.
